dossiers.title: Hotline Miami
dossiers.summary: Evidence summary: 9 validated structured observations; consult observations and conflicts for supported findings.

observations.statement: Rapid top-down room-clearing combines close-quarters attacks, firearms, enemy reactions and tactical approaches with frequent immediate restarts.
Single mistakes often end attempts instantly; learning enemy positions and attack timing through repeated retries is a defining challenge.
Animal masks add different play properties and expand approaches to clearing the same combat spaces.
An electronic soundtrack and neon pixel-art presentation reinforce the intense, disorienting 1980s crime atmosphere.
Missions consist of compact combat locations linked by cryptic narrative scenes rather than a persistent open world.
Short stages and rapid reset rhythm produce fast bursts of action, but repeated failure can become exhausting.
Some players criticize unpredictable doors or fast enemy responses and find the punishing trial-and-error rhythm frustrating.
The surreal plot invites interpretation rather than a straightforward linear explanation and is part of the game's identity.
Replaying levels can remain rewarding due to alternate combat strategies and attempts to improve execution, despite repeating the same spaces.

conflicts.statement: For some players the intense death-and-retry combat creates flow and accomplishment; for others it is tiring and arbitrarily punishing.

dossiers.title: My Dream Setup
dossiers.summary: Evidence summary: 8 validated structured observations; consult observations and conflicts for supported findings.

observations.statement: Players create and furnish their own rooms, experimenting with furniture, computer peripherals, decorations and interior colors.
There is no traditional campaign, missions or combat; the central goal is arranging an appealing personal space.
A relaxing, cozy, low-pressure creative atmosphere is repeatedly highlighted as the activity's main appeal.
Furniture positioning, room shapes and controls can restrict precise layouts and frustrate ambitious designs.
Playing consists of iterating on interior concepts rather than accumulating character levels or winning scripted challenges.
Enjoyment depends on whether trying new layouts remains interesting; players seeking clear objectives may find the sandbox slight.
Some 2024 players struggled to leave blueprint mode; the discussion included a control hint but does not establish a current widespread defect.
Users value shared or custom Workshop furniture, though one player criticized moderation and findability of useful assets.

conflicts.statement: A wide selection of design options makes room creation relaxing for some, while those seeking exact dimensions or flexible geometry may feel constrained.

dossiers.title: Super Hexagon
dossiers.summary: Evidence summary: 9 validated structured observations; consult observations and conflicts for supported findings.

observations.statement: A single triangle circles a center shape under left-right input while walls rush inward; any collision immediately ends the attempt.
Surviving increasingly rapid obstacle patterns for a minute requires intense visual attention, precise control and many retries.
Beating the early difficulty stages unlocks harder variants; progress is largely demonstrated by personal survival records.
Minimal graphics, screen movement and an energetic electronic soundtrack combine into a distinctive arcade audiovisual rhythm.
Spinning views and flashing visuals can create visual overload, headaches or motion discomfort for sensitive players.
Extremely short restarts and recurring patterns can be hypnotic and motivating, though repeated failure is exhausting for others.
The game is organized around brief survival attempts and progressively harder modes, without story missions or exploration.
Players often describe a strong sense of reward after finally surpassing a survival threshold despite simple controls.
Two-direction controls are easy to understand but reacting instantly to wall movements and camera rotation is unforgiving.

conflicts.statement: The same flashing, rotating presentation that makes the game exciting also causes dizziness or eye strain for some players.
